lines.zh: 这个梦是怎样结束的呢？

lines.en: Tired of sleeping on the floor,
lines.zh: 德黑兰有个年轻人，他睡在地板上，感到厌倦，

lines.en: a young man in Teheran saved up for years to buy a real bed.
lines.zh: 于是积蓄了好几年，买了一张真正的床。

lines.en: For the first time in his life,
he became the proud owner of a bed which had springs and a mattress.
lines.zh: 拥有了一张带弹簧和床垫的床，他为此感到十分自豪。

lines.en: Because the weather was very hot,
he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
lines.zh: 他便把床搬到了屋顶上。

lines.en: He slept very well for the first two nights,
but on the third night, a storm blew up.
lines.zh: 但第三天晚上，暴风雨突然降临。

lines.en: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof and sent it crashing into the courtyard below.
lines.zh: 一阵狂风把床从屋顶上刮了下来，摔到了下面的院子里。

lines.en: The young man did not wake up
until the bed had struck the ground.
Although the bed was smashed to pieces,

lines.zh: 但那个人却奇迹般地没有受伤。

lines.en: When he woke up, he was still on the mattress.
lines.zh: 他醒来时，仍然躺在床垫上。

lines.en: Glancing at the bits of wood and metal that lay around him,
lines.zh: 他看了一眼周围的木头和金属碎片，

lines.en: the man sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house.
lines.zh: 伤心地抱起床垫，把它搬进了屋里。

lines.en: After he had put it on the floor,
he promptly went to sleep again.
